title: Deep Researcher with Sequential Plan Reflection and Candidates Crossover (Deep Researcher Reflect Evolve)
models_tested: Deep Researcher with Reflection and Crossover (Ours, powered by gemini-2.5-pro)
findings: The proposed 'Deep Researcher' model achieved an overall score of 45.95 on doctoral-level research tasks in the 'Religion' academic discipline. The breakdown scores were 43.71 for Comprehensiveness, 47.16 for Insight, 46.83 for Instruction Following, and 46.67 for Readability.
references: Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Chiwei Zhu, Xiaorui Wang, and Zhendong Mao. Deepresearch bench: A comprehensive benchmark for deep research agents, 2025.
